items.name: Staff of the Stars
items.appearance: A black cane with embedded gems.
items.function:
1. While holding the staff, using corresponding scenes in your mind, holder will directly descend to their desired destination. The prerequisite was that the outlined scene had to be absolutely correct.
2. While holding the Staff, if some Beyonder powers or figures appear in your mind, this cane will reenact the corresponding powers and person.
3. Any foes struck by it will randomly mutate or encounter various strange effects.
items.downside: If the staff is left unsealed with no one holding it, various anomalies would appear around it unpredictably.

items.name: Box of the Great Old Ones
items.appearance: A three-layered old jewelry box.
items.function:
1. The first layer of the box can turn everything in a targeted place into toys and swap it with its own internal space.
2. The second layer recorded different locations. Once it was released, the holder and the living beings within its effective range would randomly head directly to the corresponding region. Depending on their luck, they could end up in places like the Abyss or the Cosmos.
3. The third layer of the box seals something extremely powerful, horrible, and dangerous.
items.downside: The holder of the box will disappear randomly, die, or change to a new holder.

items.name: Thorned Crown
items.appearance: A thorned crown.
items.downside: Needs to be supplied with blood to activate its power.

items.name: Theater With Curtains That Never Draw
items.appearance: Unknown

items.name: Angel of Concealment
items.appearance: An expressionless woman with black eyes.
items.function:
* Erases people.
* Descent vessel of the Darkness Pathway Deity.
items.downside: Cannot be controlled. The range of abilities randomly fluctuates.

items.name: The Last Banquet
items.appearance: Unknown
items.function: Based on a Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker.

items.name: Quill of Alzuhod
items.appearance: A common quill.
items.function:
1. Can make what it writes happen if it is possible and without the participants knowing, except if they notice the coincidences.
2. The more you know about 0-08, the more it knows about you and everyone around you.
items.downside: Tries to kill user, causes a backlash when used.

items.name: Magic Wishing Lamp
items.appearance: A golden lamp covered with mysterious and complicated symbols
items.function: Able to grant up to 10 wishes of its holder.
items.downside: The granted wish would always come in a distorted and horrible manner and accompanied with terrible consequences. The holder can avoid the harm brought by the first two wishes, through proper wording and preparations, but the third wish will have terrible consequences.

items.name: Trunsoest Brass Book
items.appearance: A book bound by thin brass sheets.
items.function: Introducing laws, offenders of the law will automatically be punished accordingly or the action itself will become impossible to do.
items.downside: It cumulatively writes new laws, eventually creating a system wherein one would be punished regardless of what they do, that includes the user himself, unless he could negotiate immunity with it.

items.name: Salinger's Blood Banner
items.appearance: A charred banner. The flagpole is iron-black metal, and there are a large number of dangerous blood spots on the banner.

items.name: Scroll of God
items.appearance: An ordinary oil painting in a brass frame, but the content depicted inside will change from time to time.
items.function: There are various effect corresponding to each scene depicted by the painting.
items.downside: If the oil painting is left unattended and unappreciated, the characters in it will come alive, comes out from the oil painting, and enter the real world.

items.name: Gift of the Land
items.appearance: A giant, withered tree trunk.
items.function: Various High-Sequence abilities of the Mother Pathway.
items.downside:
1. User has high chance of death if certain conditions are not met.
2. Dying people within a 50km vicinity will turn into an Evil Spirit unless killed by a family member or if they can leave the range of the artifact.
3. Will randomly cause the land within a 300-kilometer range to become desolate.

items.name: Pale Death
items.appearance: A pale mask with glittering metallic lustre.
items.function: The wearer's surroundings "die", even lifeless objects.
items.downside: Slowly turns the user into an undead and enslaves them.

items.name: Sage Frontlet
items.appearance: A frontlet with a vertical diamond eye in the centre.
items.function: Allows the wearer to turn into an immaterial illusory knowledge form.
items.downside: Wearing it too long is the equivalent of taking a Sage potion. One will either successfully advance or lose control and become a monster.

items.name: Proof of Glory
items.appearance: A crown that seemed to coalesce from dawn's light. Its ancient design exuded splendor, majesty, pride, and resilience.
items.function: Create defensive power in form of a cage.

items.name: Book of Calamity
items.appearance: A yellowish-brown book.

items.name: Shadow of the Beauty Goddess
items.appearance: A blurry figure formed from crimson moonlight.

items.name: Black Emperor's Crown
items.appearance: A crown inlaid with many dark gems

items.name: Destined Madness
items.appearance: Long-necked silver flask.

items.name: Cloak of Stars
items.appearance: A deep black Warlock Robe.

items.name: Solomon's Mask
items.appearance: An asymmetrical black and gold mask.

items.name: Post-Apocalyptic Scripture
items.appearance: An ancient book made of sheepskin parchment.

items.name: Love's Dread
items.appearance: A glass ring with an extending sharp crystalline spike.

items.name: Calamity of Crimson
items.appearance: A crystalline, queen's crown.

items.name: The Setting Sun Rooster
items.appearance: A black, three-headed rooster.

items.name: Eye of God
items.appearance: A vertical eye-shaped tiara.

items.name: Tamara's Everchanging Card
items.appearance: A card with changing images on both sides.

items.name: Pillar of Severity
items.appearance: A blackened stone pillar with a faint bronze hue.

items.name: Robe of Divine Blood
items.appearance: A crimson robe.

items.name: Die of Probability
items.appearance: An ordinary die with red pips on each of its faces.
items.function: Uncontrollably affects the luck of the user.

items.appearance: A golden bird-shaped accessory.
items.function: Connect to the River of Eternal Darkness
